name: modules-builtin
about: `modules` 段里不需要外部服务的写法：agentLoop / modelProvider / tools / context 绑到内置实现（enabled: true, provider: pilotdeck），skills / knowledge 照常——与不写 modules 时行为相同（skill 管理、系统提示词里的 skills 段、发给模型的请求）。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
modules:
  agentLoop:
    enabled: true
    provider: pilotdeck
  modelProvider:
    enabled: true
    provider: pilotdeck
  tools:
    enabled: true
    provider: pilotdeck
  context:
    enabled: true
    provider: pilotdeck
  skills:
    enabled: true
    provider: pilotdeck
